excerpts.text: # Home Care in Edison

![Home Care in Edison](https://cdn2.visitingangels.com/corporate/img/CaregiverCompassion.webp)![Home Care in Edison](https://cdn2.visitingangels.com/corporate/img/CaregiverCompassion.webp)![Home Care in Edison](https://cdn2.visitingangels.com/corporate/img/m-home-care-services.webp)

Trusted home care from Visiting Angels® Somerset is available for seniors with all kinds of age-related issues in the Edison area. Many elderly adults in the local community require aid with their everyday routines in order to live on their own in the long run. Without at-home support of some kind, these seniors often face an unwanted move into a care facility.

Our team is determined to help the seniors in our local area avoid what is often a stressful move away from their home environment. Our caregivers and the services they provide make it possible for older individuals in various circumstances to continue living in the space they call home and maintain a home life that they cherish.
## More About Our Home Care Services

We've seen just how valuable the opportunity to live at home can be for seniors, and we would love to make this possible for your loved one. If they have been showing signs of needing more assistance than usual or you worry constantly about their well-being, simply put their care in the trusted hands of one of our professionals.

We'll proudly design a service plan that caters to the needs of your parent or grandparent and adapts to their normal routine and preferred schedule. Using your feedback to ensure your needs as a family caregiver are also met, we'll only finalize this plan when your family feels it's just right for your loved one.
Our care options include but are not limited to those listed below:
- Aid with tasks like getting dressed, grooming, and toileting
- Offering important reminders about medication intake
- Driving care recipients to their doctors' appointments
- Taking seniors on fun outings and running errands
- Giving tired family caregivers the chance to take time off
- Assisting with mobility and walking to prevent falls
- Doing light housework to promote a better home environment
- Cooking and planning meals
## Get Started With Home Care in Edison

Learning more about what our local agency offers is simple thanks to our free consultations. We can schedule to come to your loved one's home for a face-to-face visit with you both. In this way, we can comprehensively answer your questions and learn more about their needs for care in:
- Edison
- Somerset Township
- Franklin Township
- [Piscataway](https://www.visitingangels.com/somersetnj/home-care-piscataway)
- [Hillsborough](https://www.visitingangels.com/somersetnj/home-care-hillsborough)
- Or a town in the surrounding areas
Just call Visiting Angels Somerset today to reserve a no-cost home care consultation in the Edison area!
